name: Toxic Nodular Goiter
description: Toxic nodular goiter (TNG) (or toxic multinodular goiter, or Plummer's disease) is a condition that can occur when a hyper-functioning nodule develops within a longstanding goiter. This results in hyperthyroidism, without the eye bulging effects seen in Grave's disease. These toxic nodular goiters are most common in women over the age of 60.
